records.title: A blitz of bends: decompression sickness in four students after hypobaric chamber training
records.locator: Printed pp. 600–602, Case Histories, Figure 1 and Discussion

case_rows.onset_description: Morning following the chamber flight, after attempting to equalize pressure.
case_rows.symptoms: Neck pain and right elbow paresthesias.
case_rows.resolution: Symptoms resolved after recompression except for focal sensory loss the authors considered pre-existing.
Pain resolved with oxygen before recompression. The authors report complete recovery.

case_rows.onset_description: Woke from sleep the following morning.
case_rows.symptoms: Bilateral knee and low back pain, difficulty breathing, and transient bilateral foot numbness.
case_rows.resolution: The authors report complete symptom resolution during hyperbaric treatment.

case_rows.symptoms: Left elbow and shoulder pain and left arm numbness in an ulnar distribution.
case_rows.resolution: The authors report complete symptom resolution during hyperbaric treatment.

records.source_pressure_discrepancy: Case Histories give the completed peak of 32,500 ft. Figure 1 depicts a higher peak near 10,671 m. The higher figure is retained as a figure-specific value.

observations.note: The broader 4/27 numerator is the same four cases as 4/9 on the affected flight. The completed peak and gas history for the other exposures are not reported. The source prints 14.9%.
